description: Land Acquisition - Thuththiriwewa and Ihala Kobeigane, Kobeigane D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Madiwela, Maharagama D/S Division, Colombo District - Amendment to the notice published in Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1822/3 of 05.08.2013
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land acquisition matters, including specific lot numbers, land descriptions, ownership details, boundaries, and acquisition procedures under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains multiple notices about land parcels being acquired for public purposes, with detailed descriptions of properties, their extents, and ownership claims. This fits perfectly within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) which covers land acquisitions, transfers, and property-related administrative matters.
